MCD.rationale: McDonald's presents a durable franchise with healthy YoY growth (+9.4% revenue, +6.9% EPS) and elite margins (31.6% net, ~45% operating), but the case is constrained by three factors. First, valuation is materially unquantifiable — the PE series is entirely broken (all zeros across 12 observations), preventing rigorous own-history comparison; an implied ~23.8x P/E at 4.40% 10-year yields offers limited margin of safety. Second, sequential deceleration is real: QoQ revenue -7.9%, EPS -12.6%, OCF -29.6%, raising questions about trajectory sustainability. Third, U.S. low-income consumer erosion is a genuine cyclical headwind (U.S. comps of 3.9% missed 4.2% consensus; 28 downward vs 4 upward EPS revisions in 90 days). Offsetting these: the franchise model is structurally sound (~95% franchised, real-estate-backed, $38B TTM loyalty sales), oil's -30.6% decline is an unpriced cost tailwind, the equity deficit is narrowing (-$3.45B to -$1.29B), and the stock is at its 52-week low ($264.54) with fundamentals growing YoY. The NEXT strategy details deferred to September limit near-term catalysts. Net: a good business at a potentially reasonable but unverifiable price, with cyclical headwinds and no near-term re-rating catalyst — mildly attractive but low conviction.

QoQ deceleration: revenue -7.9%, EPS -12.6%, OCF -29.6% — sequential softness raises trajectory questions

~95% franchised, $34B+ Q1 systemwide sales, $38B TTM loyalty sales across 70 markets — durable franchise moat

sources_cited.excerpt: Revenue from franchised restaurants was $4.01 billion, while sales by company-owned restaurants were $2.32 billion

Global systemwide sales exceeded $34 billion in the quarter, while systemwide sales to loyalty members were over $9 billion for the quarter and more than $38 billion over the trailing twelve-month period across 70 loyalty markets
roughly 95% of those restaurants were franchised and targets to reach 50,000 restaurants and 250 million 90-day active loyalty users across 50 markets by 2027

U.S. comparable sales growth of 3.9% in Q1 2026 falling short of analyst expectations, which anticipated a 4.2% increase and 28 downward EPS estimate revisions in the last 90 days, compared to only 4 upward
McDonald's faces its own headwinds, including restructuring charges running through 2027, 4% to 6% higher interest expense, and a 22.0% effective tax rate versus 19.8% prior year
NEXT strategy financial details are not due until the September investor event, limiting near-term catalysts
